agent_timeout: The server did not answer in time. Reload the page to see whether the change was made.
agent_unavailable: The change could not be completed. Try again.
busy: The server is busy. Try again in a minute.
database_exists: A database or database user with this name exists. Choose another name.
db_server_denied: The database server refused the panel's administrator. Check the server's privileges.
db_server_exists: A database server with this name exists. Choose another name.
db_server_in_use: The server still has databases. Delete or move them first.
db_server_local_only: This only works for databases on the local server.
db_server_unavailable: The database server is not reachable. Check it on the Servers tab or try again later.
db_server_unresolved: The database server's name does not resolve to an address this machine can reach. Check its DNS records.
dbtool_session_limit: A session can run at most two hours ahead. Extend it again later.
dbtool_unavailable: The database tool is not available. It needs the panel's own certificate; see System.
passkey_required: This account logs in with a passkey.
passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not set up on this server. Log in with your password.
pg_client_too_old: This PostgreSQL server is newer than the client tools this Hostashi version can install. Update Hostashi first.
postgresql_not_yet: This does not work for PostgreSQL databases yet.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
setup_not_allowed: The setup token is wrong or has expired.
unknown_db_server: This database server does not exist any more. Reload the page.
